reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Duel between Elephant and Sparrow; the frame is stated correctly: the hen-plover Constance tells it to her husband Sprawl inside The Plover Who Fought the Ocean.
Kept from Ryder: the tamal-tree nest, the eggs crushed by the elephant's trunk while both parents escape, the woodpecker, the gnat and the frog, and the frog's plan carried out in full.

Age band 12+: unhatched chicks die and the elephant is blinded and killed, with grief and revenge central. The blinding is told without any injury described and the death is one calm sentence; neither is drawn.

The verses are dropped, including the one about friends 'of different caste'. Fixed before approval: the gnat is female as in Ryder, the egg-laying and blinding sentences read naturally, and a discussion question now asks what the sparrow itself contributed.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; seams measured at x=512 and y=512/1024; no text. One gpt-5.6-sol generation, no edits.
The two sparrows, the red-crested woodpecker, the frog and the tusked elephant are consistent. Panel 2 shows only a fallen branch and an empty nest, with no broken eggs or chicks.

No eye injury is drawn: the elephant's eyes are calmly closed in panels 5 and 6 with no mark, and the woodpecker waits on a branch. Panel 6 shows the elephant far from the pit; neither the fall nor the death is drawn.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children or parents.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.

Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol (gpt-6.1-sol is not available to this account) and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
